name: Nizhnekamskneftekhim
note: Rubin Kazan premium sponsor; NKNH (НКНХ) logo on the front of the 2026-27 home shirt (official club store product photos, 2026-10-03). Rating note: proposed Concern. 83% of the company is held by SIBUR-RT, which SIBUR Holding owns outright; China's Silk Road Fund and Sinopec each hold 8.5% of SIBUR (Interfax, 2024-11-05), i.e. ~14% of Nizhnekamskneftekhim effective for the Chinese state.
